quote: I used to build the week in a spreadsheet on Sunday night. Now it takes ten minutes on Thursday and the whole crew has it on their phones before I leave.
name: Renee Calloway

quote: Swap requests used to come through the group chat at all hours. Now they approve themselves and I only hear about the ones that would push someone into overtime.
name: Marcus Delgado

quote: The clock-in pinned to our address ended the buddy-punching conversation for good. Payroll takes twenty minutes instead of a morning.
name: Priya Natarajan
